name: 31030 · Fort Valley, GA
findings: ZIP 31030 (Fort Valley) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31030 (Fort Valley) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 31030 (Fort Valley) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).
